##: Download URLs use underscores in the version, hence $underscoreVersion in autoupdate.url.

The vendor republishes the Windows ZIP under the same version number without bumping it: the 10.6.0 archive was rebuilt on 2026-11-12 (all entries in the ZIP carry that timestamp), which invalidated the hash recorded on 2026-11-10. checkver only detects version changes, so a silent rebuild is not caught by Excavator; run 'bin/checkhashes.ps1 -App dbschema -Update' when an install reports a hash mismatch.

autoupdate.hash reads /download/md5sums, the vendor's published checksum list, so a version bump no longer needs a 183 MiB download. format_hash turns the 32-char value into an 'md5:' hash; the top-level hash stays the locally computed SHA-256.
The find regex anchors on $basename so it cannot pick the md5 of the .exe, .msi or a different platform's archive from the same file.

bin must be the nested [[exe, alias]] form. A flat two-string array makes Scoop create two shims: 'DbSchema' (correct) and 'dbschema' (whose target resolves to the just-created shim itself), producing 'Overwriting shim' and a broken dbschema.shim that points back into ~\scoop\shims.
description: Visual database designer and manager with schema diagrams, SQL editor and data tools
